motivation: Late patch pooling cannot remove background already mixed by DINO self-attention.
pilot_policy: All seven previously measured clips stay in development diagnostics, including visually unsuitable cases. Their scores never approve image suitability.
localization: Reuse the hashed independent MobileSAM output separately computed for each exact pilot variant. Do not use SegFormer construction masks in the scorer.
aggregation: Existing mask-pooling then frame L2 normalization, all-pairs, both zero and exclude.
diagnostics: Independent scoring-mask drift under background changes
Background leakage of scoring masks beyond construction support, computed for diagnosis only
full_subject_blur: Retain as a separately reported quality intervention; uniform blur throughout a video does not necessarily reduce temporal identity consistency.
holdout: No confirmatory claim from this pilot. Freeze new acceptable images, independent construction/scoring review, prompt-disjoint evaluation groups, and all acceptance thresholds before new scoring.
natural_preference_validation: Required before a broad method-superiority claim; not replaced by blur invariance.
excellent_repair_requires: Preserved response to temporal subject changes
Adequate independent localization and sample coverage
Reproducible results on an independently frozen evaluation set
